name: Client Acquisition Suite
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y tmux cron && npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code && npm install && cd apps/web && npx prisma generate
postStartCommand: cp -n apps/extension/.env.example apps/extension/.env 2>/dev/null || true && sudo service cron start && (crontab -l 2>/dev/null | grep -q keepalive || (crontab -l 2>/dev/null; echo '*/3 * * * * /workspaces/client-acquisition-suite/scripts/keepalive.sh') | crontab -)
